notes.title: Development Update 3
notes.content:
Hello Pupper Fans and welcome to a long overdue update for the development of Walkies!
We've been hard at work with many awesome things to show you all...
[hr][/hr]
[h1]Concept Art[/h1]
The area in the current prototype was built as a small, enclosed demonstration of what we are wanting Walkies to feel like. From experimenting and nailing the art style, to movement, quests and interactive elements. After nailing the narrative journey (as mentioned in our last update), we created a series of concepts for many of the key areas across the game. Here are a few we can share with you!

This first one shows the Sanctuary's visitors centre. Here you'll learn how to play, through a tutorial area and it's also where you'll curl up and snooze after a long day running around!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43579576/e67f28b8589f412019f2b5a67a3f7b78672ba37e.png[/img]
This second one shows "Otter Lake," an area for splashing around and helping out other critters... maybe even some Otters!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43579576/573be92cb09dd68f411081a37f24091811921213.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h1]Draggables[/h1]
We wanted to be able to create some puzzles for players to solve with items they can move and so we created Draggable items.
These have a rope attached to them, so your dog can pull them around and into place. Then use the different heights (or other items) to jump from platform to platform and reach higher points!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43579576/2bda380acdb3a9637175275317c7f5aca2b8d7b6.gif[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h1]New Dog[/h1]
Our new Beagle mesh has been completed, here's a side-by-side comparison with the Beagle we currently have in our prototype.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43579576/d4c22d3f1017895b7ef7d4ed2030ef4fc99980f7.gif[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h1]New Trees[/h1]
With the Mighty Oaks sanctuary having many different species of tree across its land, we needed to have these types available to us. And so all of our trees have received an overall, including adding a few particular species for special areas.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43579576/9c9cb85d81b82227175ba1cd44d4e2bd45ac6d08.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h1]Cosmetics & Costumes[/h1]
We continue to add and update the various types of cosmetics and costumes that you can choose. Here are some of the newest additions!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43579576/c7e5ebf1025c16b284ba8323407e6ab7b804985a.gif[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h1]Shows[/h1]
In our first update, we took the prototype to a couple of shows and over the past few months, we've hit up a few more places.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43579576/0bcfa8543db4adbc582809d56926e8757b5eed38.png[/img]
First up was both FORMAT and Barclays Game Frenzy in May, with the Nottingham Game Expo in July being the latest public showcase of the game. It has been an absolute delight getting to show it to so many people!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43579576/65929441f25a9c410d763b34414a6688ae333af9.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h1]Movement, Jumping and Bug Squishing[/h1]
Hot off the events, we go through all of the bugs and feedback, generating tasks and tackling them.
A huge amount of focus has been placed on improving the movement of the dog, from tightening up turning, to adjusting acceleration, to fixing timings on jumping and climbing... all so every facet of the movement feels more responsive and enjoyable.

notes.title: Development Update 2
notes.content:
Happy Pupper Fans!

We have been hard at work on updating Walkies with so many updates that we cannot wait to share with you all!

The demo level that we have taken to various showcases has received a massive overhaul, with an all new landscape, modified grass foliage and all of the trees and bushes going through an extensive art update.
Our Beagle is receiving some visual mesh updates ahead of us sending this new build over to animation and once back, we can fix up many of the parts in the movement that we've had on the back-burner for a while... things like improving the responsiveness of the jumping and the overall IK solver system.

The main narrative arc has been completely finished, but we'll keep that one under wraps until closer to release!

Until next time, thank you all for your support and we're all super excited to get to share what we've been doing... when it's ready to show!

notes.title: Development Update 1
notes.content:
Welcome to the first update for Walkies! It’s been two weeks since we announced the game and we’ve had a crazy fortnight!

The Yorkshire Games Festival was held at the National Science & Media Museum in Bradford, UK, where we took a demo build of Walkies. We had hundreds of players try out the demo across the two days of the Family Let’s Play zone, with incredible feedback and a hefty list of things to fix or improve.

After much frantic bug fixing and tweaking as much as we could in under a week, we took the next build to the Guildford Games Festival also in the UK… where the game went down a treat! Once again we had so much fantastic feedback and another hefty list of fixes and improvements.

The game is progressing nicely, with the last two weeks getting the build running on the machines for the shows. These PCs are lower spec' than we develop on, so some time was spent profiling the game, improving the performance, tweaking config options and generally making it run smoother.

We’d like to give a huge Thank You to all the people who stopped by at our booths and played the demo!
